entries.question: Opd apointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. Here are the booking methods available:

1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department and date, fill in your patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download your slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or Health Care App by registering with your mobile number and following the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit a registration counter at KGMU with your Aadhaar card and active mobile number to complete biometric/OTP verification, pay ₹50, and collect your physical token/slip.

**Important Guidelines:**
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). 
- **Fee:** ₹50 for all booking methods.
- **Cut-off:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- **Referral:** Patients coming from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

entries.question: Oral medicine radiology me kya kya check up hote
entries.answer:
The **Oral Medicine & Radiology** department at KGMU deals with the diagnosis and non-surgical management of oral diseases, facial pain, and diagnostic imaging of the maxillofacial region. Common check-ups and diagnostic services available include:

*   **Diagnosis of Pre-cancerous and Cancerous Lesions:** Evaluation and screening for conditions like oral submucous fibrosis (OSMF), leukoplakia, and oral cancers.
*   **Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) Disorders:** Check-ups and evaluation for jaw joint pain, clicking, and restricted mouth opening.
*   **Orofacial Pain Management:** Diagnosis and management of chronic facial pain, neuralgias, and burning mouth syndrome.
*   **Maxillofacial Imaging:** Specialized dental and facial X-rays/radiological investigations required for dental and jaw pathologies.
*   **Salivary Gland Disorders:** Assessment and management of conditions affecting the salivary glands.
*   **Evaluation of Systemic Diseases with Oral Manifestations:** Identifying oral signs of underlying systemic health conditions.

**OPD Information:**
*   **Registration:** Mandatory via the [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) or the registration counter.
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM).
*   **Official Link:** For more details, you can visit the [KGMU Oral Medicine & Radiology Department Page](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=39&dept_type=1).

**1. क्या आज OPD खुली है?**
आज 26 अक्टूबर 2026, सोमवार है। Dermatology (त्वचा रोग विभाग) की OPD आमतौर पर मंगलवार, बुधवार और शनिवार को संचालित होती है। अतः आज (सोमवार) यह विभाग OPD के लिए बंद है।

**2. अगली OPD कब खुलेगी?**
Dermatology विभाग में अगली OPD मंगलवार, 27 अक्टूबर 2026 को खुलेगी।

**3. रजिस्ट्रेशन की जानकारी:**
*   **समय:** OPD का रजिस्ट्रेशन सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक होता है। काउंटर 1:00 बजे ठीक बंद हो जाते हैं।

बालों के झड़ने और स्कैल्प की समस्या के लिए आपको **Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy** विभाग में दिखाना चाहिए।
*   **स्थान:** यह OPD थर्ड फ्लोर (Third Floor) पर कमरा नंबर 303 और 304 में लगती है।

**5. फीस और खर्च:**
*   **OPD रजिस्ट्रेशन शुल्क:** सभी बुकिंग विधियों (ऑनलाइन या वॉक-इन) के लिए ₹50 का शुल्क है।
